**Title prefix:** `feat:`

## Scope

What feature or enhancement are you requesting?

## Why

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Feature is well-defined and scoped
- [ ] Implementation is complete with tests
- [ ] Documentation is updated if needed
- [ ] All quality gates pass (lint, typecheck, test, coverage)

## Out of scope

What will NOT be done in this issue (e.g., unrelated features, refactoring)?

## Reference

Reference to [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) if relevant (e.g., agent workflow, quality gates).
